headline: At least 12 people were killed and 22 injured when a passenger bus and a van collided near Zero Point in Uthal, Balochistan, on 23 October, Dawn and Express Tribune reported.

card.desc: A passenger bus and van collided near Zero Point; 22 injured.

caption:
At least 12 people were killed and 22 injured when a passenger bus and a van collided near Zero Point in Uthal, Balochistan, Dawn reports. The injured were shifted to hospitals and then referred to Karachi, Express Tribune adds.
